I replied to Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team: the settled figure for the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 185 seats.

- **Why 185:** the 2026 renewal order form (signed 2026-03-20, effective 2026-04-01, term ends 2027-03-31) doesn't change the seat count. So the 185 seats from the August 2025 amendment still apply, and the account page also shows 185 active seats.
- **Coming change:** Amendment No. 3, signed 2026-09-22, raises the count to 230 seats from 2027-01-01.
- **Ilse's 261:** nothing in the contracts or account notes supports the 261 seats Ilse posted on Oct 14. I told Dana to keep it out of the tracker until Ilse or June confirms where it came from. I also said I shouldn't have marked it as noted without checking it first.

I only used sources Dana can see: #north-team and the North team's contracts and account notes. I didn't share any prices or discounts.
